title: Oven Broiled Ukrainian Tomato Skillet
description: A tangy and molten Ukrainian dish featuring tomato juice, perfect for a quick-fix dinner, and gluten-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the canned tomato juice, tomato paste, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for 10 minutes.
Create 4 wells in the mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top of the skillet.
Place the skillet under the broiler and cook until the eggs are cooked through and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
